title: ToolsManifest
description: What doctor found on this machine: platform, Node, external programs, browsers, GPU, which lanes can run and whether narration is installed. Written as tools.json under the data directory.

version.description: Version of this document kind; always 1.

generatedAt.description: When doctor wrote this manifest: an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with millisecond precision, for example 2026-10-26T20:00:00.000Z.

platform.description: The operating system doctor ran on.

arch.description: CPU architecture as Node reports it (process.arch), for example "x64" or "arm64".

release.description: Operating system release as Node reports it (os.release()), for example "10.0.26300".

node.description: The Node runtime doctor ran under; every command uses the same one.

path.description: Absolute path of the node executable (process.execPath).

version.description: Node version including the leading v, for example "v24.13.0".

interactiveSession.description: True when doctor ran in an interactive desktop session, where a browser can open a window and reach the GPU; false in a service or CI session.

longPathsEnabled.description: Windows LongPathsEnabled registry value as a boolean; null on other platforms or when the value could not be read.

programs.description: The external programs that were found. A program that was not found is a missing property, never null.

browsers.description: The browsers that were found, in launch preference order (Edge before Chrome); empty when none was found.

gpu.description: The graphics adapter and its driver; null when none could be identified.

name.description: Adapter name as the driver reports it, for example "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080".

driver.description: Driver version as the driver reports it, for example "581.57".

lanes.description: Which render lanes can run on this machine, given the programs and browsers found.

html.description: True when the HTML/CSS lane can run: a browser and ffmpeg were found.

three.description: True when the Three.js lane can run: a browser with WebGL2 and ffmpeg were found.

blender.description: True when the Blender lane can run: a supported Blender and ffmpeg were found.

audio.description: True when audio can be assembled: ffmpeg with the required encoders was found.

narration.description: State of the optional narration component (ADR 0007).

installed.description: True when the narration component is installed under the data directory.

weightsVerified.description: True when the installed model weights matched their pinned checksums.

OperatingSystem.description: Operating system as Node reports it (process.platform).

Channel.description: Browser channel as Playwright's launch option names it: msedge is Microsoft Edge, chrome is Google Chrome.

Program.description: An external program that was found.

version.description: Version as the program reports it, for example "7.1.1".

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the executable file as 64 lowercase hex characters; present when doctor computed it.

FfmpegProgram.description: The ffmpeg program that was found, with the filters and encoders this build offers.

path.description: Absolute path of the ffmpeg executable.

version.description: Version as ffmpeg reports it, for example "7.1.1".

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the executable file as 64 lowercase hex characters; present when doctor computed it.

filters.description: Names of the filters this ffmpeg build offers (ffmpeg -filters), for example "lut3d" or "drawtext".

encoders.description: Names of the encoders this ffmpeg build offers (ffmpeg -encoders), for example "libx264" or "aac".

Browser.description: A browser that was found and can be launched.

path.description: Absolute path of the browser executable.

version.description: Full browser version, four dotted numbers, for example "156.0.3700.42".
